title: Mary Gay Scanlon criticizes White House actions and economic trends in December posts - South Delco News
text:
Congresswoman Mary Gay Scanlon, who represents Pennsylvania’s 5th district in the U.S. Congress, published a series of critical posts on December 11, 2025, addressing concerns about government actions and economic conditions.
In her first post, Scanlon alleged misuse of federal power by the executive branch: “The White House has weaponized government surveillance and law enforcement to target political opposition on the basis of their political beliefs or speech — actions that are unambiguously protected by the 1st Amendment.” (December 11, 2025)
Later that day, she commented on long-standing policy efforts: “They’ve been trying and failing to come up with ‘creative solutions’ for the past 15 years.” (December 11, 2025)
Scanlon also listed several economic indicators she says have worsened: “The Deficit: UP Grocery Prices: UP Inflation: UP Electricity Prices: UP Heating Bills: UP Credit Card Debt: UP Is this what winning feels like?” (December 11, 2025)
Mary Gay Scanlon has served in Congress since replacing Pat Meehan in 2018 as representative for Pennsylvania’s 5th District. She was born in Watertown, New York in 1959 and currently resides in Swarthmore. Scanlon holds a BA from Colgate University and a JD from the University of Pennsylvania.
